title: XAI-AMLBench v0.1.0: Synthetic Multi-Hop Money Laundering Detection Dataset and Explainable GNN Benchmark
description: A privacy-preserving, synthetic benchmark for multi-hop money-laundering detection. Includes a directed transaction-graph generator with five embedded laundering typologies (smurfing, scatter-gather, cyclic loops, shell-company chains, cross-border velocity) plus realistic benign look-alike structures, GATv2/RGCN graph neural network detectors, baseline comparisons, and an explainable-AI layer that turns GNNExplainer subgraphs into audit-ready SAR narratives. Motivated by FinCEN's April 2026 AML/CFT explainability mandate. All data is synthetic; no real customer or transaction data is used or required.
